observations:
Swin Transformer was created by Microsoft Research Asia (D5+M country). Only the architecture code is used and no pretrained weights are moved. PI confirmed no collaboration with Microsoft Research Asia, now or planned.

The WRF S2S Reforecast is an in-house dataset generated by the PI's research group and owned by KAUST. It is stored on Shaheen III CPU storage (project k10021) in the folders of a group member (luongtm). PI confirmed it is proprietary research data, used for research within this project only and kept internal. The full dataset is about 300 TB; only a subset that fits within the 80 TB of GPUP storage will be moved (for example, 10 of the 20 years, or 5 of the 11 ensemble members), selected by the PI for the research. The data has not been accessed yet.

All software and model code is under licenses that allow free use, including commercial use, except EDM (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: non-commercial use only; modified versions shared under the same license). This project's academic research use is allowed.

The proposal form lists wrong URLs for four packages: timm (points to tqdm), einops (points to the R version; version 0.8.1 exists only for the Python package), xarray (documentation page) and pandas (a sub-folder of the repository). The official repositories were reviewed.

All software comes from standard registries (PyPI, conda-forge and the official PyTorch index). CVE scan of the full software stack will be added to the audit.
